summary: Client is Blair Endodontics and Microsurgery; project replaces https://www.bemdentalcare.com/.
Website redesigned with 'Soft Modern Wellness' aesthetic for dentist practice. Uses Astro framework with component-based architecture.
Main components created: DentistHero (navbar + hero), Services (6 service cards), About (company info + credentials), Testimonials (patient reviews), CTA (call-to-action), Footer (contact + links).
Design system: Color palette uses Ivory (#FAF9F6), Sage (#A8C5B5), Sage Dark (#2A5F4F), Terracotta (#E8AE90), Warm Gray (#E8E4DF). Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans (headings) + Manrope (body).
Typography system is fully consistent across all components. All components include Google Fonts @import. All headings use Plus Jakarta Sans, all body text uses Manrope.
In this environment, Node child_process spawn/exec fails with EPERM, which breaks Astro/Vite builds that call exec("net use") on Windows.
Astro/Vite build fails in this environment because Node child_process spawn/exec is blocked (EPERM), triggered by Vite's Windows net use check.
Astro check dependencies installed: @astrojs/check and typescript.
AGENTS.md now requires running sequential-thinking at task start, using MCPs when needed, and checking for errors before commit.
For SVGs injected via set:html, scoped styles may not apply; use :global selectors to set svg width/height for visibility.
About page created at /about with sections covering Dr. Saad background, specialized endodontic expertise, patient-centered philosophy, and practice facilities.

Service offerings in src/data/serviceData.json now reflect bemdentalcare.com/services: Apexogenesis, Revascularization, Post Removal, Silver Point Removal, Separated Instrument Removal, Perforation Repair.
Service descriptions in src/data/serviceData.json were rewritten for SEO-friendly phrasing without changing meaning.
Service descriptions in src/data/serviceData.json received minor grammar/clarity edits via grammar-tone-checker.
All six service descriptions in src/data/serviceData.json were grammar-checked with minimal edits applied.
